title: feat(study): a Hide numbers switch next to Hide names [TBC]
body:
**Size:** S

Study has Hide names, to test yourself on a shirt number. A Hide numbers switch would do the reverse. The scope is still to be confirmed: whether it hides the number on cards only, or on list rows too.

### Work

- [ ] A Hide numbers switch beside Hide names in `app/team/[squadId]/study.tsx`
- [ ] The numbers hidden in the grid and, if confirmed, in the list
why: [TBC] in the title: the skill asks whether the issue is ready to work.
